regimeSub: SPX -0.5% as tech rout extends; 10Y rallies to 4.94% on pre-election haven bid with Brent crashing 4%.
themes: Q3 GDP 3.4% YoY vs Sep CPI 4.0% YoY confirms stagflation regime; Fed Warsh held at 4% Oct 28 FOMC per CNBC with hawkish bias intact → core PCE 3.1% keeps Dec hike optionality live
10Y yield drops 4bp to 4.94% as equity-to-bond rotation accelerates pre-midterms per MarketWatch → 2s10s at +38bp with 2Y down 5bp to 4.56% on flight-to-quality bid
Lagarde ECB resignation Oct 29 per Guardian creates policy vacuum → EURUSD firms to 1.1194 but successor uncertainty caps upside; BOK Nov hike now consensus per Korea Times as Fed stays hawkish
Brent collapses 4.1% to $105.16 as OPEC+ Dec targets hold per CNBC and Iran war premium fades → gold +0.5% to $3,937 as pre-election hedging offsets oil-driven disinflation hopes
